reason: This plugin is primarily a web UI cost-visualization utility for DeepSeek Harness sessions: it computes cumulative session cost from token usage, displays it live in the composer area, and updates pricing from external official pricing data with local override/fallback handling.

summaries.zh: 该插件是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 插件，会在对话输入框下方实时展示当前会话的费用和相关 token 使用信息，并在价格源异常时给出提示。
summaries.en: This DeepSeek Harness web plugin shows live per-session cost and token usage metrics in the composer area, using configured or externally synced pricing and surfacing pricing source warnings.

capabilities: Compute per-session spend from recorded model usage in session logs
Fetch pricing data from an external service and apply model/time-based pricing to calculations
Render live cost and token metrics in the web composer UI via a session projection
Persist observed pricing history locally for reuse across restarts
Display pricing-source and warning state for pricing freshness

reasons.code: README describes a sessionCost projection fed from assistant usage (input/cache/output/cacheWrite buckets) and rendered under the composer as a live status/cost line.
README documents automatic official price polling with fallback behavior and source metadata (pricingSource/pricingWarn), which implies outbound network access.
package.json declares a DSH web bundle/client plugin entry with a web platform client, confirming UI integration behavior.
